fee_notes: No traditional royalty — franchisor takes 5%-20% of Gross Sales as compensation; facility owner keeps 15%-35%; franchisee receives remainder (typically 65%). Technology fee currently $77/month (max $100, can increase 10% annually). Ongoing training fee $25/month. No separate marketing/ad fund percentage.
raw_excerpt: Compensation to Franchisor: Varies. Typically 15% to 35% of Gross Sales to the store or other facility where you are located, and 5% to 20% of Gross Sales to us. Technology Fee: Up to $100 per month, currently $77 per month.
